events.event: Komdigi and BSSN reported a wave of attack attempts on Indonesian systems, with FortiGuard counting about 2.2 million attempts in 24 hours, about half against the financial sector, and a scan showing 96.7% of readable PHP versions on .go.id hosts are end-of-life.
events.key_numbers: 2.2 million attempts in 24h (as of 10 Nov 07:30) · about 26 per second · about 1 million at financial sector · 1,621 of 1,677 .go.id PHP versions EOL (96.7%) · 69.6% of 99,896 PHP matches EOL · 0.2% patched for PHP2SHELL · BSSN 151 financial IR teams, 202 notifications, 208 advisories in 2026
events.why_it_matters: Banks and government sites are being probed at scale, and phishing posing as digital-tax notices is a risk for ordinary users.
events.spreading_evidence: Katadata terpopuler (1.6 juta serangan); several Katadata items on the front page

events.event: Google, Temasek and Bain's 2026 e-Conomy SEA report cut its 2030 forecast for Indonesia's digital economy GMV to US$227 billion from US$340 billion in the 2025 edition, as CNBC Indonesia reported on 11 Nov.
events.key_numbers: 2030 forecast US$227bn (Rp4,122tn) vs US$340bn (Rp6,174tn) · 2025 US$102bn · 2026 US$119bn · e-commerce 17% a year to 2035
events.why_it_matters: A big downgrade to the digital-economy growth story that startups and investors have been selling.

events.event: Hackers drained about US$93 million from hundreds of crypto wallets linked to Ledger hardware devices sold through reseller CryptoBilis, and Ledger said at least one device had an unauthorized hardware implant.
events.key_numbers: US$93.2m (about Rp1.6tn) from 315 wallets on 6 chains (Bitquery) · US$94.5m from 521 addresses on 7 chains (YFarmX) · Tether froze US$10m · CNBC headline says Rp1.8tn, body says Rp1.6tn
events.why_it_matters: Even a hardware wallet bought from an official reseller can be compromised before it reaches you.

events.event: Trump said he knew the FBI was investigating Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with Alice Huang, alleged by the NYT to be linked to China, while Nvidia shareholders filed a class action alleging concealment.
events.key_numbers: Dinner in Taipei 22 May 2025 · CNBC headline: Rp7,805tn vanishes (not in article body) · Lori Huang could get about Rp1,125tn in a divorce (headline)
events.why_it_matters: The head of the company behind AI chips is under investigation, which touches the AI boom that moves markets.
events.spreading_evidence: Dominates CNBC Tech and detikInet front pages (10+ headlines on 11 Nov)

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported the Trump administration is finalizing a ban on imports of new Chinese optical transceivers, which Microsoft and tech lobbies warn could halt US data-centre construction.
events.key_numbers: Microsoft building 35 US data centres, 134 more planned · Eoptolink and Zhongji Innolight hold up to two-thirds of the global market · US makers need until 2028-2029 to scale (Morgan Stanley)
events.why_it_matters: Adds another threat to the AI data-centre build-out that is already facing local opposition.

events.event: TikTok launched a standalone TikTok Shop app in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and the Philippines, but not in Indonesia, where the Shop stays inside the main TikTok app.
events.why_it_matters: Indonesian sellers and shoppers see no change for now, though the Tokopedia-TikTok setup is the regional exception.

events.event: Danantara and Telkom introduced Padisera, a national MSME marketplace extending Telkom's PaDi UMKM from B2B into B2C, with a consumer trial planned for 2027.
events.key_numbers: PaDi UMKM: 180,000+ sellers · 115,000 buyers · GMV above Rp27tn · B2C trial 2027 · first shown 26 Oct at DTIIF 2026
events.why_it_matters: A state-backed rival to Shopee and Tokopedia aimed at small sellers.

events.event: detikInet reported Xiaomi 18 Pro and Pro Max will launch globally on 17 November, and Infinix Hot 70 Pro 5G+ has launched in Indonesia at about Rp4.3 million.
events.key_numbers: Xiaomi 18 Pro/Pro Max global launch 17 Nov 2026 · Infinix Hot 70 Pro 5G+ about Rp4.3 million (headline only)
events.why_it_matters: Phone prices in Indonesia are being watched amid the memory-price squeeze.
